{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN (missing data)
df['customer_age'] = df['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Check the dtype of customer_age
print("Dtype of customer_age:", df['customer_age'].dtype)

# Now compute mean age
mean_age = df['customer_age'].mean()
print(f"Mean customer age: {mean_age}")"}
